newsitem.title: USA: SC&T to be delisted on Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: SC&T to be delisted on Nasdaq.

text.p: SC&T International Inc said Nasdaq will delist SC&T's common stock, effective July 7, citing public interest concerns about the company.

The company said in a prepared statement that Nasdaq contends SC&T failed to show it exercised sufficient due diligence and entered into capital raising transactions that excessively rewarded investors who bought SC&T's securities outside the public marketplace.

The compay said that Nasdaq also contends in its most recent placement that SC&T issued securities with an open-ended conversion feature, which resulted in stripping away shareholder interests and placed control of the company with a few offshore entities, whose principals and business operations are largely unknown to management.
SC&T said the record does not support these contentions and plans to proceed with a hearing to contest the delisting.
